questions.stem: Two worker types exist. Type H can pass a certification exam, type L cannot, the exam costs 500 dollars and a year, and firms pay 3,000 dollars for proven ability. What separating equilibrium should the market reach?
questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS

questions.explanation: A per-ton fee only has to match the damage per ton to make every firm weigh abatement against the true social cost, and firms that abate cheaply will abate more, which is exactly where the savings come from. A technology order equalises quantities rather than costs, so it makes cheap firms cut as much as expensive ones, unless the law demands one specific technology or the regulator cannot read tonnage at all.
questions.hint: Ask what each instrument equalises, quantities or costs.
